name: Pear Passwords
author: dragosol
description: Your passwords on iCloud, in a native Omarchy window. Sign in with your Apple Account and approve this computer once; passwords and verification codes sync while Pear is open. A small system service holds the keys under its own user: one fingerprint or password dialog shows your accounts, and each account asks again before it reveals or copies a password. Copies clear after one paste. Tags, category search, password history, a generator and opt-in browser autofill. Not affiliated with Apple.
